edition.publication: Paris: Jacques-Paul Migne, Patrologia Graeca3, 1857, columns119–340 including interspersed commentary
edition.title: De caelesti hierarchia, Greek and Latin in PG3

work.author: Pseudo-Dionysius the Areopagite
work.description: The Dionysian treatise, in fifteen chapters addressed to Timothy, on the heavenly hierarchy: its definition and purpose, the symbolic forms under which Scripture presents the angels, and the nine orders in three triads (seraphim, cherubim, thrones; dominions, powers, authorities; principalities, archangels, angels). A locus is chapter.section as divided in Migne, Patrologia Graeca 3, or the chapter alone.
work.title: De caelesti hierarchia
